contents.Header2: Display album art while playing music

contents.Text: This enables album art to be displayed.

contents.Image: Display album art while playing music.png

contents.Header2: Auto-clear album art when music stops

contents.Text: Enabled: This clears the image from memory when the song stops.
Disabled: Shows the image forever until the next song starts.

contents.Image: Auto-clear album art when music stops.png

contents.Text: Enabled: This writes the generated padding image to disk in the config directory, either next to the binary or in the global config directory (for more information see [[[button:Global Config Guide][/_Guides/Global Config]]]).
Disabled: Does not write the image to disk.
[[[warning:Note:]]] The value is temporarily stored in memory and is not saved persistently in the database. Consequently, it resets to [[[strong:false]]] each time the program starts.
A quick summary of what each combination does. The sections below explain each setting in more detail.

rows: Shrunk to display size, then effect (fast)
Not shrunk, effect at main image size
Shrunk to display size, then effect
Not shrunk, effect at full resolution (slowest)
Shrunk to display size from 4096px, then effect
Shrunk to drawn size from full source
Shrunk to display size from full source, then effect

contents.Header2: Fit images to the display size

contents.Text: Enabled: Shrinks the main image to the size it is drawn at, and sizes the background to cover the whole display area. This uses far less memory and processing. This overrides [[[strong:Enable the source image for effects]]], which is disabled while this is on.
Disabled: Keeps the normal behaviour, where the main image keeps its source quality (up to the [[[warning:4096x4096]]] limit unless high resolution images are enabled).
[[[warning:Note:]]] Images may look softer if the window is enlarged afterwards (for example going fullscreen) until the next song loads.

contents.Image: Fit images to the display size.png

contents.Text: Enabled: This ignores the [[[warning:4096x4096]]] pixel limit. While [[[strong:Fit images to the display size]]] is on, the image is resized straight from the full-resolution source, which is slightly sharper but slower to load and uses more memory.
Disabled: Enforces the [[[warning:4096x4096]]] pixel limit ensuring any images bigger are resized down to reasonable sizes.

contents.Header2: Enable the source image for effects

contents.Text: Enabled: Runs the effect at the main image's resolution for the highest quality effect padding, at the cost of speed and memory.
Disabled: Runs the effect on a smaller copy sized to the display, which is the cheapest and lowest quality option.
[[[warning:Note:]]] This setting is ignored, and cannot be changed, while [[[strong:Fit images to the display size]]] is enabled.

contents.Image: Enable the source image for effects.png

contents.Text: This pads images to centre them and adds an effect on the padding area.
Click to open selections.
Off: Turns off the effects at all.
Randomiser: Randomized from selected effects. (See [[[strong:randomiser Options]]] below)
Tick what options you want the randomiser to select when starting a new song.
This menu is hidden when the randomiser is not selected as the [[[strong:Image Padding Mode]]].
All options in this category use the cpu for effects.
[[[warning:Note:]]] All cores of the cpu are used to speed up processing time and limit the amount of time the program affects other programs (games).
[[[warning:Note:]]] Thus this can cause frame rate drops for a second while its processing to avoid this use gpu if possible.
All options below are use the gpu for the effect process. (Faster than cpu and does not effect gaming frame rates while cpu does)
